# What can you pay for this junk car and still make money?

> Free junk car buyer calculator: the most you can offer for a scrap or salvage car after weight, converter, parts, tow, storage and labour. Profit at the seller's ask and the farthest tow that still pays. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
